description.value:
Usage drawn on a creature

This awe-inspiring rune of pointed curves is rumored to have been part of the magic that alghollthus used to call down the meteoroids of the Earthfall cataclysm. The rune-bearer senses a foreboding shadow overhead and that something terrible is about to happen. This dread is contagious. The rune-bearer becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.3uh1r86TzbQvosxv]{Doomed 1}, and its allies that begin their turn adjacent to the rune-bearer also become doomed 1 for 1 round. Each creature doomed this way takes @Damage[10[mental]] damage the first time each round it attempts an attack roll or skill check.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.3jqT6b9IFgIamOr7]{Effect: Ochygholl, The Poisoned Star}

Invocation (fire) The rune calls a meteorite down on the rune-bearer, fulfilling its terrible promise. Each creature in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] centered on a corner in the rune-bearer's space takes @Damage[3d10[bludgeoning]] damage with a basic Reflex save. Then, each creature within a @Template[type:burst|distance:40] centered on that same corner takes @Damage[8d6[fire]] damage, also with a basic Reflex save. This invocation has the death trait for doomed creatures.
